 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh

Appearance:
 Shri Sushil Goswami - Advocate for the applicant.
Shri B M Patel - P.P. for respondent/State.

Order 
This is first application under Section 483 of BNSS has been filed by the applicant for grant of bail.

2. The applicant has been arrested on 18.05.2025 in connection with Crime No.5/2025 registered at Police Station Jigna, District Datia for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 468, 467, 471,
354, 323, 504, 506 of IPC.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the case and he has not committed any offence.
He further submits that after about four years of execution of forged sale deed private complaint was filed by the complainant under Section 156(3) of Cr.P.C., thereupon FIR was registered.
He submits that the applicant is mere a witness to the sale deed dated 3.3.2021 and in fact he has not committed any offence or received any money from the vendor.
The applicant is in NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:11639 2 MCRC-24009-2025 custody w.e.f. 18.5.2025.
Applicant is permanent resident of District Datia.
Hence, he prays that applicant be released on bail.
4. Learned counsel for the respondent/State opposed the application and prays for its rejection.

sentences.text: 5. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary available on record.
6. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and arguments made by learned counsel for the parties, I deem it proper to release the applicant on bail.
Accordingly, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

7. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned Trial Court for his appearance before the Trial Court as and when required.
He shall abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of CrPC/482(3) of BNSS.
8. Certified copy as per rules.
